title: A House for the Bell
author: Petra Coldharbour
blurb: Hazel Thackeray, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, has spent twelve years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must get the family out ahead of the count before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
